title: DTCR source packet
description: One immutable external artifact admitted as raw material for the dual-track method. Identity is content, not location: the artifact object has no url, path or host field to fill in, so a packet cannot be bound to a copy that moved or changed. Classification is fixed at SOURCE_PROPOSAL because an article, transcript, slide deck or conversation export describes what someone proposed, and reading it produces no repository fact. The only promotion a packet admits is the per-claim split into SOURCE_STATEMENT, and even that carries no repository authority: a statement is what the source said, never what the tree does.

file_name.description: Bare name only. A separator or a tilde would make this a location on one machine, and the local path of a source is never recorded in a public artifact.

artifact.description: Byte count and digest together are the identity. Two artifacts with the same name are the same packet only when both agree.

classification.description: Fixed. A source packet is a proposal about the world; it is not an observation of this repository and cannot be recorded as one.

admissible_promotions.description: The complete set. Splitting a packet into per-claim statements is the only move this packet licenses.

never_promoted_into.description: Written out rather than implied. A reader who never sees the refused list fills it in with whatever the source sounded most confident about.

disposition_ref.description: The source-disposition record set that judged this packet's claims. A packet with no disposition has been read but not adjudicated.

retrieval_hint.description: Named extension point. A consumer may carry private locator variable names here; it may never carry a resolved private URL or private content, and nothing downstream may treat a hint as identity.

resolver_variable.description: A variable name the consumer resolves locally, never the value it resolves to.
